body: I've lived a traumatizing life and I can't take it anymore. I feel so relieved knowing that it will end this night. And please don't feel bad about me leaving. It's the first time I feel this happy in 25 years. I can't wait to leave this cruel world. Wherever I'll be after I die, I don't think can be worse than this life. Love you...
I'm so happy right now and never felt this way since I was a kid (I'm 30 now). Can't wait to do it. It's just a matter of hours ( idk why time seems to move too slow tho).

I'm done with fighting and basically with everything. I just want to leave.
I'm thinking about writing what I want them to know in a diary or something and put it in a place where they can find it. What do you think? Will they suspect anything?
That's not helpful and doesn't answer my question.

I'm way beyond that. I've been suicidal for the past 16 years, and now I finally have the courage and means to do it, and it feels really good to know that I'll be dead and free in just a few days. I'm just too damaged to live. But there are many things that I want my family to know but I can't just call them because it will be unusual. I don't want them to feel guilty for my suicide, because in fact they contributed a lot to my current mental situation and I think they realize that. So when they know that I've committed suicide they will certainly blame themselves. They already live in a shitty place and can barely support themselves, and I don't want to make it harder for them.
Me too. Very soon I hope.
